understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by getting every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with a '+' in the semantic grid, with the requirement that if there are multiple goal tiles they must all be occupied by selectable pieces at the same time to trigger a WIN and advance through all levels until the full run reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: There is always a currently selected piece. Actions like CLICK attempt to move (or sometimes select) using the clicked coordinate as the intended destination/interaction point; if the path or landing tile is invalid, the piece does not move and the step is still consumed. Directional moves like MOVE_RIGHT try to move the selected piece one step in that direction but are blocked by walls/obstacles (and possibly other pieces). Walls/obstacles prevent movement; attempts that hit blocking geometry result in no position change. Selection can be changed by clicking on another selectable piece (when applicable), otherwise clicks act as movement attempts for the currently selected piece.
